mechanism_claims.claim_text: DGL13K and LGL13K have source-supported phenotypic antibacterial activity in MIC/MBC assays, with DGL13K showing broader activity against the tested S. aureus strains.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC/MBC assays establish phenotype and bactericidal context, not a direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports lower human-cell toxicity for DGL13K at antibacterial concentrations, with toxicity reaching LD50 only at much higher concentrations than MIC.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DGL13K and LGL13K against human cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Safety/selectivity context is not a direct antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DGL13K reduces P. aeruginosa burden in Galleria and mouse burn wound infection models at the tested local doses.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DGL13K in in vivo infection models
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo efficacy does not identify a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The local paper does not provide a direct target, binding, pore-formation, or omics assay sufficient to classify a direct molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GL13 peptide analogs in this paper
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a publication-grade caution, not a rework blocker, after local XML/PDF/package review.
